metadata.title: Pet Food Energy Database
metadata.important_note: Registros con energía verificada en páginas de fabricante. Se conserva la URL fuente por producto. No se han generado kcal por estimación cuando el fabricante no las publica.
metadata.scope: Dog and cat commercial dry/wet foods with a published energy value. Treats intentionally excluded from the mass-import sources.
metadata.quality_policy: No missing kcal values were estimated. kcal/kg and kcal/g are arithmetic conversions of a published kcal/100g or manufacturer kcal/kg value.
metadata.regional_warning: Recipes can differ by country and can be reformulated. UK catalogue values should be checked against the current local pack/manufacturer sheet before clinical use.

petfood_co_uk.note: Independent UK evidence catalogue. It preserves source-published energy values and leaves unpublished energy blank rather than estimating it.
